global_caveats: fp8 KV everywhere (--kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3). MTP/NEXTN spec ACTIVE every decode (--speculative-algorithm NEXTN --speculative-num-steps 3 --speculative-eagle-topk 1 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 4).

CUDA graphs: decode + target-verify + draft graphs captured on all 4 ranks. Prefill CUDA graph auto-DISABLED in every cell ('Breakable CUDA graph is incompatible with multimodal model' — fired for FP8 and Q6 boots; AWQ prefill backend likewise 'disabled' in boot config).

Fork's co-location NCCL handling engaged (logged): custom all-reduce disabled (heterogeneous GPUs + co-located ranks -> NCCL for TP collectives), NCCL_MULTI_RANK_GPU_ENABLE=1 auto-set (requires NCCL >= 2.30 — the reason this is docker-only), NCCL_MAX_CTAS capped to 4 for 2 co-located ranks (override via env).
mem_fraction_static derived per-rank from the absolute budget: 13500 MiB / 5090-total -> 0.7324 (logged). Even 1/4 TP split, no uneven ratios, no DCP — V1/V2 variants do not apply to this scenario.
UNCACHED verified: unique-nonce token-id prompts; max_cached_tokens=0 every cell.

Q6 GGUF is multimodal (mmproj-BF16 auto-loaded next to the backbone). Booted with --skip-server-warmup (M27d lesson: the image's built-in warmup sends an IMAGE request which OOMs at maxed KV pools; text-only bench never touches the vision path). GGUF cells booted with DROP_CACHES=1.
Battery pushes 3080s to 78-84 C by the end of each cell (gpu_temps_after) — thermal gate between boots is doing real work.

Harness fix during this part (F3-class, same as M27a-F3/M27b-1): htsglang_dk_run.sh MODELPATH pointed at the HOST mount path; bench_measure runs on the VM and needs the VM-local models-cache path for the tokenizer. q8_tp4.status: INFEASIBLE — recorded WITHOUT a boot attempt (per task; known loader infeasibility, task #64)
q8_tp4.error_reference: M27d (TP=3, same image code at HEAD 3e76cbbf1, TP-mode-independent): UD-Q8_K_XL loads past the shard-quantized check, but ALL 64 GDN layers log 'Parameter model.layers.N.linear_attn.in_proj_qkvz.qweight not found in params_dict', then the scheduler crashes: model_loader/loader.py:2252 -> layers/quantization/gguf.py:475 _create_padded_weight_param -> AssertionError: Data container has mixed dtypes: {torch.float16, torch.uint8}. The fused GDN in_proj_qkvz is stored mixed-precision (fp16+uint8) in Q8_K_XL; the GGUF QuantMethod padding path assumes ONE dtype. Q6_K_XL loads cleanly in the same plugin => Q8_K_XL-specific layout. Fix = implement mixed-dtype/incomplete-quant GGUF layers (flagged to main as TODO); outside measurement scope.
notes: shvllm rejects the same checkpoint earlier with a different error mode (is_layer_skipped fused-shard check, M27b) — same root cause, both engines INFEASIBLE on Q8_K_XL.
